ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Medicaid policy violations
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the poor policy language that may have cost $1.7B across 14 Medicaid services in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Follow the money to uncover the extent of the issue and potential for recovery of funds.
questions: What were the specific policy language issues?
How widespread are these issues across Medicaid services?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant financial mismanagement and lead to important policy changes.

ideas.title: Impact of Trump administration's funding freezes
ideas.description: An examination of the effects of the Trump administration's funding freezes on various projects, including the Gateway Tunnel Project.
ideas.angle: Analyze the implications of these funding decisions on infrastructure development and local communities.
questions: What are the specific projects affected by the funding freezes?
How will these freezes impact local communities?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger pattern of politically motivated funding decisions with significant consequences.
